notes.subject: El
notes.rationale: אֵל here is God ('they tested God'); kept as El, but some read it adjectivally 'they tested (His) strength'

notes.subject: תאוה
notes.rationale: 'hangre tumas long wanpela laik' renders craving/desire; no single Tok Pisin word covers ta'avah

translation: Na ol i hangre tumas long wanpela laik bilong ol long ples wail long graun, na ol i traimim El long ples nogut i tanim nogut.
